name: Earth
description: Earth is the only world where life has been confirmed. Liquid oceans, a protective atmosphere, and a magnetic field help make our home a remarkable place.

name: Mars
description: Mars is a cold desert world with a thin atmosphere. Iron minerals give it a rusty red color. Ancient riverbeds and water-altered rocks offer clues to a wetter past.

name: Saturn
description: Saturn is a gas giant surrounded by rings made mostly of ice. The Cassini spacecraft studied this extraordinary world, its rings, and its many moons.
